bootstrap_unit: whole IST weeks within year and observed period, with replacement; fixed Run 7 structure
comparison_interval: mixture of 20 actual refitted normalisations and 500 year/seven-day observed daily block resamples, with centred nested OOF residuals; pooled weather joint 300 common donors per city/refit
baseline_ncap: both calendar 2017 and 2018 required; recent both 2024 and 2025 required; PM2.5 proxy, no official compliance
explanations: exact tree-path-dependent TreeSHAP; 30 complete days per era/season, whole hourly days when hourly target; aggregate signed contributions per day before mean absolute; grouped circular wind direction; ALE 12 quantile bins / 12 angular sectors
gam: Gaussian statsmodels GLMGam, cubic B-splines df=6 for nonconstant continuous predictors, fixed alpha=10; explicit circular sine/cosine; same outer weeks; no post-result penalty tuning
interpretation: associations, predictive weather-only R2 is not causal variance decomposition; no causal policy claims; no forecasts/RAG/simulator/dashboard
